<hr>
<pre>public static final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapPolyline.SolidRepresentation</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Representation for a solid line without outline.
 <p>Can represent polylines that have constant width or width dependent on the map zoom.
 <p>To achieve constant width lines, use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> with a single value.
 <p>To achieve line width dependent on map zoom, use <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> with
 multiple values.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure.Kind</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>RenderSize.Unit</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#PIXELS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.PIXELS</code></a> is supported.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.core.Color,com.here.sdk.mapview.LineCap)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>SolidRepresentation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;SolidRepresentation&#8203;(@NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;lineWidth,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;color,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-linecap" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">LineCap</a>&nbsp;capShape)
                    throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a representation for a solid line without outline.
 <p>At map measures smaller than smallest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the smallest
 map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures bigger than biggest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the biggest
 map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measures line width is
 linearly interpolated between width values given for these map measures.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure.Kind</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>RenderSize.Unit</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#PIXELS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.PIXELS</code></a> is supported.
 <p><code>lineWidth</code> must not be 0 (<code>lineWidth.sizes</code> with all values set to 0.0).</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>lineWidth</code> - <p>The width of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>color</code> - <p>The color of the polyline.</dd>
<dd><code>capShape</code> - <p>The cap shape applied to both ends of the polyline.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.core.Color,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.core.Color,com.here.sdk.mapview.LineCap)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>SolidRepresentation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;SolidRepresentation&#8203;(@NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;lineWidth,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;color,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;outlineWidth,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;outlineColor,
                           @NonNull
                           <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-linecap" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">LineCap</a>&nbsp;capShape)
                    throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a representation for a solid line with outline.
 <p>The total width of the polyline is <code>line width + 2 * outline width</code>.
 <p>At map measures smaller than smallest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 and <code>outlineWidth</code>, the value is constant and equal to the width given for
 the smallest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code> and <code>outlineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures bigger than biggest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code>
 and <code>outlineWidth</code>, the value is constant and equal to the width given for
 the biggest map measure in the <code>lineWidth</code> and <code>outlineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measure is
 linearly interpolated between width values given for these map measures.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure.Kind</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>RenderSize.Unit</code></a> only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#PIXELS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.PIXELS</code></a> is supported.
 <p><code>lineWidth</code> must not be 0 (<code>lineWidth.sizes</code> with all values set to 0.0).</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>lineWidth</code> - <p>The width of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>color</code> - <p>The color of the polyline.</dd>
<dd><code>outlineWidth</code> - <p>The width of the outline on one side of the polyline depending on
     the map measure.</dd>
<dd><code>outlineColor</code> - <p>The outline color of the polyline.</dd>
<dd><code>capShape</code> - <p>The cap shape applied to both ends of the polyline.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>

 line width is constant and equal to the width given for the smallest

<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;getOutlineWidth()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the map measure dependent polyline outline width.
 <p>The total width of the polyline is <code>line width + 2 * outline width</code>.
 <p>At map measures smaller than smallest map measure in the <code>outlineWidth</code>,
 outline width is constant and equal to the width given for the smallest
 map measure in the <code>outlineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures bigger than biggest map measure in the <code>outlineWidth</code>,
 outline width is constant and equal to the width given for the biggest
 map measure in the <code>outlineWidth</code>.
 <p>At map measures between two nearest given map measures, the values are
 linearly interpolated between values given for these map measures.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The width of the outline on one side of the polyline depending on the map measure.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
